nonpassing.message: Refused loudly, a resource-planning limitation: the level's T# is s_load-ed through a pointer computed from buffer-loaded bounds (s_flbit, clamped by s_min to user data), so the host cannot evaluate the image before the dispatch, and the tracker enumerates device-selected images only for the s_ff1 bit-scan selector over an SGPR soffset (ResourceTracker.TryMakeDirectImage).
Wide lines: Metal has no wide lines, so a PA_SU_LINE_CNTL width above one pixel is drawn one pixel wide with a one-time warning.

RDNA2 rounding of a sub-LSB compare reference against a D16 texel is not documented (the ISA and PAL leave it open); Metal's sample_compare rounds the reference to 16 bits. Not an emulator decision to pin.

IMG_FORMAT 43 (11_11_10_FLOAT, R in the low ten bits) has no Metal pixel format; the emulator binds it as a null texture with a one-time warning (ResourceMaterializer, the unsupported-format fallback)

Refused loudly, a resource-planning limitation: the level's T# is s_load-ed through a pointer computed from buffer-loaded bounds (s_flbit, clamped by s_min to user data), so the host cannot evaluate the image before the dispatch, and the tracker enumerates device-selected images only for the s_ff1 bit-scan selector over an SGPR soffset (ResourceTracker.TryMakeDirectImage).

Assert.True() Failure
Expected: True
Actual:   False

RDNA2 rounding of a sub-LSB compare reference against a D16 texel is not documented (the ISA and PAL leave it open); Metal's sample_compare rounds the reference to 16 bits. Not an emulator decision to pin.

Refused loudly, not fixable on the host: Metal has one stencil reference per face for both the compare and the replace, so STENCILOPVAL != STENCILTESTVAL under a compare is a fatal (DepthTargetResolver.ConvertFace).
